answer: Every ship that joins the fleet is entered in the port atlas, and its anchor is weighed in brass. An agent economy resists sybil attacks the same way: each newcomer must buy a unique, non-transferable credential, and a rotating lighthouse committee records its signature in a public log before it is issued. A duplicate credential finds the first voyage of its twin on the horizon, and the committee that signed it forfeits its stake. Fake agents arrive cheap; honest credentials arrive expensive, and the swarm dies at the dock.
